title: Hangover-cure Pungent Peruvian Potatoes Stew
description: A hearty Peruvian stew made with potatoes, sesame seeds, and ají amarillo peppers to help cure hangovers. This dish is a staple in Peruvian cuisine, often served with rice and avocado.
instructions: Heat the duck fat in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it's translucent and starting to caramelize, about 8 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the diced aji amarillo peppers and cook for 2-3 minutes, until they start to soften.
Add the cubed potatoes, ground cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Pour in the chicken broth and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20-25 minutes, until the potatoes are tender.
Stir in the sesame seeds and heavy cream. Cook for an additional 5 minutes, until the sauce has thickened.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with chopped cilantro or scallions if desired.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
